name: Cottage Pie
subtitle: Beef and lentil filling with carrots and peas under a Yukon gold mash, with steamed broccoli
equipment: 12-inch oven-safe skillet (or skillet + 9×13 dish), large pot

macros.portion: A fifth of the pie (about 1¾ cups: 1 cup filling under ¾ cup mash) and about 1 cup broccoli.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Includes the broccoli.

before: **1½ lb ground beef** thawed in the fridge.
Can be assembled up to a day ahead: cover and refrigerate before baking.
notes: A small amount of lentils cooks right in the gravy, adding fiber and stretching the beef without changing the dish. Tomato paste and Worcestershire give it depth, so no canned tomatoes are needed. Greek yogurt in the mash replaces most of the usual butter and cream; keep the 2 Tbsp butter for flavor.

items: ½ cup brown lentils, dry, rinsed
½ cup nonfat plain Greek yogurt

steps.title: Prep the filling vegetables
steps.body: Dice **1 onion** and **2 carrots** (½-inch) into one bowl. Mince **4 cloves garlic**. Rinse **½ cup lentils**.

steps.title: Brown the beef
steps.body: Oven-safe skillet over medium-high, **½ Tbsp olive oil**, then **1½ lb beef**. Leave it **4 min** to brown, then break up and cook **3–4 min** more. Spoon off any fat.

steps.title: Build the filling
steps.body: Add the onion and carrots and cook **4 min**. Stir in the garlic and **2 Tbsp tomato paste** for **1 min**, then **2 Tbsp flour** for **1 min**. Add **2 cups bone broth**, **2 Tbsp Worcestershire**, **1½ tsp thyme**, the lentils, **½ tsp salt** and **½ tsp pepper**, scraping the bottom. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low **25 min**, stirring now and then, until the lentils are tender.

steps.title: Potatoes, during the simmer
steps.body: Heat the oven to 425°F. Peel **3 lb potatoes** and cut into 1½-inch chunks. Into a large pot with cold water to cover and **1 Tbsp salt**. Boil, then simmer **12–15 min** until a knife slides in easily.

steps.title: Mash
steps.body: Drain the potatoes, return them to the warm pot, and mash with **2 Tbsp butter**, **⅓ cup milk**, **½ cup Greek yogurt**, **½ tsp salt** and **¼ tsp pepper** until smooth.

steps.title: Finish the filling
steps.body: Uncover the filling and stir in **1½ cups frozen peas**. If it's soupy, simmer uncovered **2–3 min** until it's a thick gravy that holds on a spoon. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Top and bake
steps.body: Spread the mash over the filling (in the skillet, or move the filling to a 9×13 dish first), seal it to the edges, and rough the top with a fork. Scatter **¼ cup parmesan**. Bake **20 min** at 425°F, then broil **2–3 min** until browned in spots. If you assembled it ahead and it's cold from the fridge, bake **35–40 min** instead.

steps.title: Broccoli and rest
steps.body: Let the pie rest **5 min** while you microwave **2 bags broccoli** per the package.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Cut into fifths. Each plate: one wedge of pie and about **1 cup broccoli**.

after: Leftovers keep 4 days in the fridge and freeze well; reheat covered at 350°F or in the microwave.
